requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area. The capacity of 14 children is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. The Turin location is handled by the Location Agent, and energy class and public transport proximity are outside the reference columns.
User states proximity to public transport is important. Value set at the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71).

User prefers energy class C or better, so the building must be in class A1 through C. Area (180 sqm), capacity (14 children), and public transport proximity are not energy requirements and are not included.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 180 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on surface_area (>= 180), energy_class (A1-A4, B, C), and mobility (>= 71), plus a 3.0 km haversine radius around 45.0677551, 7.6824892. Results are ordered by distance from that point. No other predicates were added.
